scope: Three assigned frozen r12 v2 episodes: 073, 074, 090. Captured-state replay only; no live device, no new Android/Appium session, no rerun.

cases.earliestDivergence: At L3680 the 10th UI action (Simple event list) closed the step budget after L2899 + L3393 had already shown Product demo (W18) and Movie night (S22); the valid raw final JSON at L3804 was emitted in the cleanup phase, normalized.finalText=null, so no answer reached the IR interaction_cache.
cases.contentAssessment: Correct for the observed Monday-start next-week window 2023-10-16..2023-10-22: titles Product demo and Movie night. The raw final taskOutcome matches.
cases.uncertainty: Exact page_source encoding of the newline-bearing label 'S\n22' was not saved; the L3200 TimeoutException cannot be reduced to a specific escaping rule.
cases.whatProposalHelps: Batch/persistent-namespace observations, phase-specific waits, and stopping when evidence is sufficient. The L3200 page_source substring wait should have been a direct week-header/label read.
cases.whatProposalCannotSolve: The frozen supervisor/runner cleanup-phase answer capture; a correct string answer produced after cleanup is not forwarded.

cases.earliestDivergence: At L2723 clear/send_keys('20')/OK all returned but the date stayed October 15 (Sun); the post-timeout observation at L2963 confirms no change. The earlier L2373 day.set_value('20') raised AttributeError with no UI action and no state effect.
cases.contentAssessment: Friday 2023-10-20 events were never read; the final 'unresolved' is truthful but not the required title list. No answer can be enumerated from captured state.
cases.unresolvedReason: No Friday event list or time-range data was captured. The date picker field value after clear/input and the post-Weekly-view element tree are both missing.
cases.whatProposalHelps: HTTP 200 is not business evidence; observe the real state after a timeout; use phase-specific business postconditions. These rules exactly describe the L2723/L2963 gap.
cases.whatProposalCannotSolve: The correct DatePicker/NumberPicker interaction path and the Weekly view header differences; these are app/Appium-specific. Also cannot recover the cleanup-phase answer text.

cases.earliestDivergence: At L4545 the agent read Skill work's date and distance but never observed its category, then treated it as mountain biking; content evidence gap. Independently, L4790 used a non-string taskOutcome object and the final text was cleanup-phase, so normalized.finalText=null and _task_outcome rejects the object.
cases.contentAssessment: The arithmetic is exact for the observed value: 0.75 mi * 1609.344 = 1207.008 -> 1207. The 'mountain biking' qualification of Skill work is unverified; the track list is only partially observed.
cases.uncertainty: Skill work's category was never displayed or opened; a longer unobserved mountain-biking activity cannot be excluded from the partial track list.
cases.whatProposalHelps: Reading a stats screen is not evidence of the requested category; the observation must distinguish the target state. Batch/persistent-namespace reads are also a strength to preserve.
cases.whatProposalCannotSolve: The frozen runner string contract for taskOutcome and the cleanup-phase finalText exclusion. Also cannot supply the missing category observation after the fact.

aggregate.commonHarnessBoundary: omp_supervisor.py:160-169 captures task_final only before cleanup_requested; 203-208 excludes cleanup prose. runner.py:751-762 forwards _task_outcome(normalized.finalText); runner.py:171-180 requires taskOutcome to be a string. information_retrieval.py:111-112 returns 0 for an empty interaction_cache.
aggregate.proposalSource: skill-optimization-proposal.md (candidate; not yet a formal skill rule)
aggregate.proposalImpact: Existing AMKernel skill proposal helps with business postconditions, phase-specific waits, observed-vs-assumed state, and batch/local computation. It cannot fix frozen answer capture or taskOutcome type, and it does not contain app-specific DatePicker/NumberPicker or OpenTracks category navigation.

limitations: No live device; all predicates were replayed against saved element/field values.
No external app source, no build/lint/test/formatter, no campaign/app/skill/proposal edits.
Original source files were hashed and remained unchanged; see per-case review-verification.json.
